title: PHANTOM TAG: MANIFEST
description:
"PHANTOM TAG: MANIFEST" is a strategic asymmetric multiplayer game where two factions clash in 4v4 battles.

Will you play as a Thief and steal the hidden treasures, or as a Ghost and hunt down the Thieves? The choice is yours.

You have 8 minutes on the clock.

Make the most of each character's unique traits and work together with your team to claim victory.

Thief: Steal the Artifacts!

The Thief's objective is to transform treasures hidden across the map into Artifacts and steal them.

Collect 10 treasures to transform them into an Artifact, then have your entire team throw 5 Artifacts out the window to win.However, the Ghosts are on your trail to stop you, so stay hidden while completing your objectives.

Captured teammates can be rescued from the prison cage, "Hitokago."

Exploration, stealth, rescue…

Knowing what to do at any given moment and adapting to the situation is the key to victory.

Ghost: Catch the Thieves and throw them in jail!

The Ghost's objective is to find and capture the Thieves before the Artifacts are stolen.

Once you catch a Thief, imprison them in the cage "Hitokago" located on the map.

The Ghosts win by imprisoning all 4 Thieves simultaneously, or by protecting 5 Artifacts until time runs out.

Players who choose Ghost play from a first-person perspective.

Use the sounds and presence given off by the Thieves to track them down, then corner them using skills and map gimmicks.

Ghosts do not have overwhelming power over the Thieves.

Coordinating with your teammates and herding them skillfully is the key to success.
description_short: Thief vs. Ghost! A strategic asymmetric multiplayer game where two factions clash in 4v4 battles. Will you play as a Thief and steal the hidden treasures, or as a Ghost and hunt down the Thieves? The choice is yours. Work together with your team and claim victory within the 8-minute time limit!
